name: Duke University
character: The main campus features Collegiate Gothic buildings of multicolored Duke stone on West Campus, Georgian-style buildings on East Campus, expansive gardens, and surrounding forest.

landmarks.name: Duke Chapel
landmarks.quote: Duke Chapel stands at the center of West Campus on the highest ridge.
landmarks.look: Tall 210-foot Collegiate Gothic stone chapel standing on a ridge.

landmarks.name: Sarah P. Duke Gardens
landmarks.quote: One of the major public attractions on the main campus is the 54-acre (220,000 m2) Sarah P. Duke Gardens
landmarks.look: Expansive gardens with terraces, native plants, arboretum, and winding paths.

landmarks.name: Cameron Indoor Stadium
landmarks.quote: including the historic basketball stadium, Cameron Indoor Stadium – are on West Campus.
landmarks.look: Historic indoor basketball stadium on West Campus.

landmarks.name: Lilly Library
landmarks.quote: Lilly Library, Baldwin Auditorium, a theater, Brodie Gym
landmarks.look: Georgian-style campus library building on East Campus.

landmarks.name: Nasher Museum of Art
landmarks.quote: Central Campus is home to the Nasher Museum of Art
landmarks.look: Art museum building on Central Campus.

landmarks.name: Baldwin Auditorium
landmarks.quote: Lilly Library, Baldwin Auditorium, a theater, Brodie Gym
landmarks.look: Georgian-style auditorium hall on East Campus.

landmarks.name: Craven Quad
landmarks.quote: The residential quads on West Campus are Craven Quad, Crowell Quad, Edens Quad
landmarks.look: Unadorned Collegiate Gothic residential quadrangle on West Campus.

landmarks.name: Allen Building
landmarks.quote: Duke University Allen Building was the site of student protest in the late 1960s.
